provenance.locator: Candidate C boundary (HITL 1): incidental, initial, multiple solid-only discrete/circumscribed nodules, at least one >=6 mm; HITL 2: fleischner_multiple_solid_all_lt_6mm=false reused as the >=6 mm set state under the Fleischner whole-nodule average-diameter convention; GR-6/GR-7 exclusive by construction (architecture confirmation 6262113692 items 2-3).
